book_meta.work: Le Tour du monde en quatre-vingts jours
book_meta.author: Jules Verne

sentences.ar: وبعد الجسر، بروكتور صار يمشي بالعربات.
sentences.en: And after the bridge, Proctor began walking through the cars.
And saw the cards, and stood watching.
You should have played the king!

sentences.ar: وفوغ قال: يمكن بلعبها بجولة تانية.
sentences.en: And Fogg said: perhaps I play it in another round.
Proctor said: I told you we would meet!

sentences.ar: وعودا صار وجهها أبيض، وفيكس قام.
sentences.en: And Aouda's face went white, and Fix stood up.
Fogg said: at the next station.

sentences.ar: وفوغ قال: يا سيدتي، هو شتمني.
sentences.en: And Fogg said: madam, he insulted me.

sentences.ar: وفيكس قال: أنا رح أكون شاهدك.
sentences.en: And Fix said: I will be your second.

sentences.ar: وباسبارتو قال بقلبه: يا رب، خلي المحطة بعيدة.
sentences.en: And Passepartout said to himself: Lord, let the station be far.

sentences.ar: وبالمحطة، الكمساري قال: ما في وقت، القطار بيتأخر.
sentences.en: And at the station, the conductor said: no time, the train is late.
But you can fight in the last car.
And Fogg and Proctor went to the last car.

sentences.ar: كل واحد بمسدس، وبينهم عشرين خطوة.
sentences.en: Each with a pistol, twenty paces between them.
And before three, there was screaming.
And Passepartout ran, and shouted: Indians!

sentences.ar: وفوغ وبروكتور تركوا المبارزة، وركضوا للشبابيك.
sentences.en: And Fogg and Proctor abandoned the duel, and ran to the windows.
And fired together, at the same side.
